g.text: When a Woman Ascends the Stairs
The Tale of the Princess Kaguya
The Story of the Last Chrysanthemum
The Brothers and Sisters of the Toda Family

svg.text: Where the Eye SitsJapanese cinema from 1927 to 2023, one mark per shot, floor to sky

g.text: length: how long the shot holds
a gap: nobody in the frame
drawn one band up: the camera sits higher
After each title, three squares: height, movement, empty frames
documented for the film or the director
not known: drawn at the usual eye height, flat, unbroken
